# opnsense_auth_group (Resource)

Local groups (System > Access > Groups). Members are referenced by user ID (`uid`), so use `opnsense_auth_user.<name>.uid`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# A read-only helpdesk group, allowed to log in from the management network only.
resource "opnsense_auth_group" "helpdesk" {
  name        = "helpdesk"
  description = "Read-only diagnostics"
  privileges = [
    "page-dashboard-all",
    "page-diagnostics-arptable",
    "page-diagnostics-logs-system",
  ]
  source_networks = ["192.168.10.0/24"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Group name.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Group description. Defaults to `""`.
- `members` (Set of String) User IDs (`uid`) of the members, e.g. `["0"]` for root. Leave unset to leave membership unmanaged here, for example when users join through `opnsense_auth_user.group_memberships`.
- `privileges` (Set of String) Privilege IDs granted to the group, e.g. `page-all` or `page-diagnostics-arptable`. Defaults to `[]`.
- `source_networks` (Set of String) Networks (CIDR) members may log in from. Empty allows any. Defaults to `[]`.

### Read-Only

- `gid` (String) Numeric group ID assigned by OPNsense.
- `id` (String) UUID of the group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Import by UUID
terraform import opnsense_auth_group.example 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000
```
